content.rendered:
“11. And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst

of Samaria and Galilee. 12. And as he entered into a certain village, there met him
ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:”
(Luke 17: 11-12)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

In our Focal Scripture, Jesus bypassed Samaria and Galilee and healed ten lepers He
met in a ‘certain village’. Jesus left places that had names and performed a mighty
miracle in a place that had no name. Galilee and Samaria had names, but the certain
village got a supernatural experience.

Friend, pay more attention to your ‘certain village’. Pay more attention to that
relationship that seems too small to be rewarding. Pay attention to ideas that other
people are overlooking. Pay attention to insignificant opportunities around you. Pay
attention to people around you who appear insignificant in your eyes. Pay attention
to the little skills that don’t seem to attract a resounding applause.

As Jesus performed a mighty miracle in that ‘certain village’, so will He grant you
uncommon miracles and mighty visitations through the most unlikely sources. Those
unlikely ideas and opportunities are about to deliver unimaginable treasures to you
in a matter of time.

Jesus came into that certain village, and though it was an unlikely place, a mighty
result came forth. If Jehovah is involved, even if you are in an unlikely place, God
will show up with unlikely miracles.

If Jehovah is involved, the equation of your location may be incomplete, but God
will complete it. When Jehovah is involved, what is missing around you won’t be
enough to stop what God will do for you.

Ask God to grant you uncommon miracles and breakthroughs from unlikely sources. Ask
God to show up in your ‘certain village’ and spring a surprise for you.

Pray With Me: Lord, grant me uncommon miracles from unlikely sources, in Jesus’ name!
